exposure: history of prenatal ultrasound in previous pregnancy
outcome: timing of the first prenatal ultrasound utilization
cohort: The study participants were 442 women who gave birth at health institutions in Ambo town, central Ethiopia.
finding: Overall, 71% of participants received timely prenatal ultrasound, with urban residence, previous prenatal ultrasound use, attending ANC at a hospital, and good knowledge identified as significant factors.
